title: test_lci_auth: per-verb assertion message in sensors/location loop
description: Reviewer pass-3 finding (from wjlr): python/tests/coap/test_lci_auth.py:429 loop assert resp.code == NOT_FOUND does not name the failing verb, and failure on iteration N masks verbs N+1..3. Fix options: add assert message f'{code} got {resp.code}', or parametrize over (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) for per-verb test IDs. Diagnosability only; test is correct when passing.
